gate_round5_guard.if_wrong: a clean draw with an unread least is a least the exact test says changes a sub-cell's share and the scheme did not read: reported with its pixel's cause, the guard and the line not moved; a lost-branch count of zero on a draw is a draw on which the guard cannot discriminate, reported with whether dropping the branch moves any pixel there
gate_round5_guard.cannot_discriminate_if: a draw with no two-branch pixel (the test asserts some), the lost-branch count zero, or the truth's re-measurement at four times its samples moving the worst clean draw by more than the truth's floor
